cause: Concurrent verifier container creation exhausted local storage and left unreferenced init/partial writable layers.
approval: Automatic review initially rejected manual layer removal; user then explicitly approved the four identified orphan pairs.
scope: Only the listed directories and corresponding -init directories were removed after a fresh cache-id/mount-id/init-id reference check. Database volumes were not deleted.
reversible_preparation: Removed graphos-verifier:local through Docker image rm to create room for the recovery helper, then rebuilt from the updated Dockerfile.
operational_followup: Run local VFS browser verification serially; production disk admission, host scheduling, and storage failure recovery remain deployment gates.
